description: Read one active The2410 microservice using a service_id returned by search-services-tool, e.g. svc_8f3k2m9qxa. Returns content, scope with exclusions, buyer requirements, questions_before_order with ids, attributes, and all packages with their IDs, prices, currencies and delivery estimates in business days. Compare package requirements and scope with the customer's task before selecting a package. To order, pass the chosen package and answers to prepare-order-tool. This tool does not create an order, collect payment, or call an AI provider.

service_id.description: The service_id returned by search-services-tool, e.g. svc_8f3k2m9qxa. Not a package ID.
